title: Black alder twig and water ripples at Wolfsberger Mühle, 2019-06-29
description: A twig of black alder (Alnus glutinosa), a piece of deadwood, and water ripples formed by a rising gas bubble. Photographed at the Wolfsberger Mühle on the Reppeliner Bach, about two kilometers north of Tessin in the Rostock district, within the Stormsdorfer Bachtal nature reserve.
author: Radomianin
